source.note: Canonical manual mappings for verified non-standard MSF mechanics whose player-facing names are confirmed from official game text. Mechanical source IDs are preserved; no mapping is inferred from translation alone.

evidence.note: Official French and English Angel ability text uses the player-facing terms 'Vitalité' and 'Vitality'. Repository audit confirms Grace is used only by Angel in two playable abilities: one application in the passive 'Ange gardien' and one removal in the basic 'Coup d'ailes'.
Official Adam Warlock ability text confirms the internal source name 'Marked' corresponds to the player-facing effect 'Vulnérable' / 'Vulnerable'.
Official Adam Warlock ability text confirms 'Darkness' is displayed as 'Ténèbres' in French.
